svg.title: How the block table maps positions of request C to KV cache slots
svg.desc: Request C has 17 tokens. Positions 0 to 13 already have KV in the cache, and positions 14 to 16 are computed in this step. The block ID list of C is 9 and 4. Positions 0 to 15 divide by 16 to index 0, which is block 9, and position 16 divides to index 1, which is block 4. Block 9 holds slots 144 to 159, so C14 and C15 are written at slots 158 and 159. Block 4 holds slots 64 to 79, so C16 is written at slot 64 and the rest of block 4 waits for positions 17 to 31.

g.text: positions 17–31 of C will be written here in later steps
KV from earlier steps, read by attention
New KV this step, written at its slot
